summary: Defines a Management Information Base (MIB) module for managing DS3 and E3 interfaces, the higher-capacity digital lines used by carriers. It gives SNMP-based tools standard objects for monitoring and configuring them. It was replaced by RFC 3896.

eli5.summary: This is a standard checklist for inspecting very big digital phone lines. Any monitoring program can ask the same questions of any maker's equipment and understand the answers.
